systems.notes: 36 components on the official components index (includes M3 Expressive, May 2025). Web implementation (Material Web) is unavailable for several Expressive components.

components.name: Button groups
components.purpose: Groups related buttons into one row and animates them together when pressed or selected.
components.notes: M3 Expressive (May 2025). Standard and connected variants; connected button group is the Expressive replacement for segmented buttons.

components.name: Buttons
components.purpose: Lets people trigger an action with a labeled tap target.
components.notes: Variants: elevated, filled, filled tonal, outlined, text; Expressive adds toggle (selected/unselected) buttons and 5 sizes.

components.name: Extended FABs
components.purpose: A floating button with icon and label for the screen's single primary action.
components.notes: Documented as its own component (separate from FAB).

components.name: FAB menu
components.purpose: Opens from a FAB to show a short list of related actions.
components.notes: M3 Expressive; replaces the older speed-dial idea. Comparable to Ant FloatButton.Group.

components.name: Floating action buttons (FABs)
components.purpose: A prominent floating icon button for the screen's primary action.
components.notes: Sizes FAB, medium, large (small FAB no longer recommended in Expressive). Ant equivalent: FloatButton.

components.name: Icon buttons
components.purpose: A compact button showing only an icon for a single action.
components.notes: Standard, filled, tonal, outlined; can act as a toggle.

components.name: Segmented buttons
components.purpose: A row of joined buttons for picking one or several options, switching views, or sorting.
components.notes: Distinct component in M3; equivalents: Carbon Content switcher, Ant Segmented. No longer recommended in Expressive (use connected button group).

components.name: Split buttons
components.purpose: A main action button joined to a menu button offering related options.
components.notes: M3 Expressive. Equivalents: Carbon Combo button, Fluent SplitButton, Ant Dropdown.Button.

components.name: Date pickers
components.purpose: Lets people pick a single date or a date range.
components.notes: Variants: docked, modal, modal input (range supported).

components.name: Time pickers
components.purpose: Lets people pick and set a specific time.
components.notes: Variants: dial and input.

components.name: Loading indicator
components.purpose: Shows that something is loading during a short wait, using a morphing shape.
components.notes: M3 Expressive; for waits under ~5s, distinct from progress indicators.

components.name: Progress indicators
components.purpose: Shows the real-time status of an ongoing process.
components.notes: Linear and circular; determinate/indeterminate; Expressive wavy style.

components.name: Navigation bar
components.purpose: Bottom bar for switching between top-level views on small screens.
components.notes: Expressive 'flexible navigation bar' replaces the original.

components.name: Navigation drawer
components.purpose: Side panel listing destinations for switching views on large screens.
components.notes: Standard and modal. No longer recommended in M3 Expressive; use expanded navigation rail.

components.name: Navigation rail
components.purpose: Vertical side bar of destinations for mid-sized screens.
components.notes: Collapsed and expanded (Expressive); expanded rail can be modal and replaces the drawer.

components.name: Bottom sheets
components.purpose: A surface anchored to the bottom of the screen showing secondary content or actions.
components.notes: Standard and modal.

components.name: Side sheets
components.purpose: A surface anchored to the side of the screen showing secondary content.
components.notes: Standard and modal. Equivalents: Ant Drawer, Fluent Drawer, Carbon UI shell right panel.

components.name: App bars
components.purpose: Bar at the top of the screen with the page title, navigation, and key actions.
components.notes: Page title is 'Top app bar'. Variants: search app bar, small, medium flexible, large flexible. The bottom app bar now lives under Toolbars.

components.name: Badges
components.purpose: Small marker showing a count, notification, or status on icons and nav items.
components.notes: Small (dot) and large (number).

components.name: Cards
components.purpose: A container that groups content and actions about one subject.
components.notes: Elevated, filled, outlined.

components.name: Carousel
components.purpose: A scrollable row of items, usually images, that moves on and off screen.
components.notes: Layouts: multi-browse, uncontained, hero, center-aligned hero, full-screen.

components.name: Checkbox
components.purpose: Lets people select one or more items or turn an option on or off.

components.name: Chips
components.purpose: Compact elements to enter info, make selections, filter content, or trigger actions.
components.notes: Four types that are distinct components elsewhere: assist (action), filter (selection), input (like Ant Tag closable / Fluent Tag / Carbon dismissible tag), suggestion.

components.name: Dialogs
components.purpose: A modal window that asks for a decision or a short focused task.
components.notes: Basic and full-screen.

components.name: Divider
components.purpose: A thin line that separates or groups content.
components.notes: Full-width and inset.

components.name: Lists
components.purpose: A vertical index of rows with text, icons, or images.
components.notes: One-, two-, three-line items; Expressive adds segmented/expressive list styles.

components.name: Menus
components.purpose: A temporary surface showing a list of choices.
components.notes: Dropdown menu; Expressive vertical menus with submenus. Exposed dropdown menu (select) is documented under menus/text fields.

components.name: Radio button
components.purpose: Lets people choose exactly one option from a set.

components.name: Search
components.purpose: Lets people type a keyword or phrase to find relevant content.
components.notes: Search bar and search view (full-screen or docked results surface).

components.name: Sliders
components.purpose: Lets people choose a value or range by dragging along a track.
components.notes: Standard, centered, range; horizontal/vertical in Expressive.

components.name: Snackbar
components.purpose: A brief message at the bottom of the screen about an app process, with an optional action.
components.notes: Equivalents: Ant message, Carbon toast notification, Fluent Toast.

components.name: Switch
components.purpose: Toggles a single setting on or off.

components.name: Tabs
components.purpose: Organizes related content into switchable views at the same level.
components.notes: Primary and secondary tabs.

components.name: Text fields
components.purpose: Lets people enter and edit text.
components.notes: Filled and outlined; multi-line (textarea) is a text field configuration.

components.name: Toolbars
components.purpose: A bar of frequently used actions for the current page.
components.notes: Docked and floating toolbars (Expressive); docked toolbar replaces the bottom app bar.

components.name: Tooltips
components.purpose: A small label or message that explains an element on hover, focus, or long-press.
components.notes: Plain and rich tooltips (rich tooltip can hold title, text, and action; like Carbon Toggletip).

systems.notes: 41 entries in the official components index (incl. Multiselect and UI shell), plus variants that ship as separate React components, 2x Grid (Elements), and Skeleton (Loading pattern). Other patterns (common actions, dialogs, disabled states, disclosures, empty states, filtering, forms, global header, loading, login, notifications, search, text toolbar) are guidance built from core components; empty state, tearsheet, side panel, page header live in IBM Products/Carbon platform, not the core index (community index deprecated).

components.name: Accordion
components.purpose: Stacked headers that expand and collapse to show or hide sections of content.

components.name: AI label
components.purpose: Marks AI-generated content and opens a popover explaining the AI.
components.notes: Formerly 'AI slug'. Default and inline variants. Carbon-specific; no equivalent in the other three systems.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.purpose: Shows where the current page sits in the site hierarchy with links back up.

components.name: Button
components.purpose: Triggers an action; the label says what will happen.
components.notes: Primary, secondary, tertiary, ghost, danger; icon-only button and button set are covered here.

components.name: Checkbox
components.purpose: Lets users select one or more options, or toggle a single option.

components.name: Code snippet
components.purpose: Shows a piece of code that the user can copy.
components.notes: Inline, single line, multi-line.

components.name: Contained list
components.purpose: A list of related items grouped inside a labeled container, often with actions per row.

components.name: Content switcher
components.purpose: A row of joined buttons to switch between alternate views of the same content.
components.notes: Equivalent to M3 Segmented buttons / Ant Segmented.

components.name: Data table
components.purpose: Displays rows and columns of data with sorting, selection, expansion, and batch actions.
components.notes: Variants: default, with selection (radio/checkbox), with expansion; includes toolbar, batch actions, pagination integration.

components.name: Date picker
components.purpose: Lets users enter or pick a date or date range, optionally with a calendar.
components.notes: Simple date input, calendar picker (single/range); time picker documented on the same page.

components.name: Dropdown
components.purpose: Lets users pick an option from a styled list to fill a form or filter/sort content.
components.notes: Page documents three variants that are separate React components: Dropdown, Multiselect (incl. filterable), Combo box.

components.name: File uploader
components.purpose: Lets users choose one or more files to upload.
components.notes: Button uploader and drag-and-drop uploader.

components.name: Form
components.purpose: Groups related input controls so users can submit data or configure options.
components.notes: Also a pattern: /patterns/forms-pattern/.

components.name: Inline loading
components.purpose: Small inline indicator showing an action is in progress, then success or failure.

components.name: Link
components.purpose: Text that navigates to another page or resource.

components.name: List
components.purpose: Ordered or unordered bulleted list of text items.
components.notes: Unordered and ordered.

components.name: Loading
components.purpose: Spinner showing that data is loading or a slow process is running.
components.notes: Can be a full-page overlay or local.

components.name: Menu
components.purpose: A temporary list of actions or options that opens from a trigger.
components.notes: Supports nesting, selectable items, danger items.

components.name: Menu buttons
components.purpose: Buttons that open a menu of options.
components.notes: Page covers three separate components: Menu button, Combo button (split button), Overflow menu.

components.name: Modal
components.purpose: A window on top of the page that focuses attention on one task or message.
components.notes: Passive, transactional, acknowledgment, progressive, danger variants; sizes xs–lg.

components.name: Multiselect
components.purpose: Dropdown that lets users select several options, optionally with filtering.
components.notes: Listed separately in the components index but documented on the Dropdown page.

components.name: Notification
components.purpose: Messages that tell the user about status, updates, or results.
components.notes: Four variants that are distinct components elsewhere: inline (Fluent MessageBar / Ant Alert), toast (M3 Snackbar / Fluent Toast / Ant notification), actionable, callout.

components.name: Number input
components.purpose: Lets users type a number and step it up or down.

components.name: Pagination
components.purpose: Splits content into pages with controls to move between them.
components.notes: Pagination (table-style with page size) and Pagination nav (page-number links).

components.name: Popover
components.purpose: A layer that pops over the page to show extra content attached to a trigger.
components.notes: No tip, caret tip, tab tip.

components.name: Progress bar
components.purpose: Horizontal bar showing how far a process has progressed.

components.name: Progress indicator
components.purpose: Shows completed, current, and upcoming steps in a multi-step task.
components.notes: Stepper; equivalent to Ant Steps.

components.name: Radio button
components.purpose: Lets users choose exactly one option from a set.

components.name: Search
components.purpose: Field for typing a word or phrase to find content.
components.notes: Expandable variant exists.

components.name: Select
components.purpose: Native-style control to choose one value from a list.
components.notes: Default and inline select.

components.name: Slider
components.purpose: Lets users pick a value or range by dragging a handle along a track.
components.notes: Single and range.

components.name: Structured list
components.purpose: A simple list of rows and columns for reading, optionally selectable.

components.name: Tabs
components.purpose: Switches between related views within the same context.
components.notes: Line and contained; icon-only and vertical tabs.

components.name: Tag
components.purpose: Labels, categorizes, or filters items using short keywords.
components.notes: Read-only, dismissible, selectable, operational tags (selectable ~ Ant CheckableTag; operational ~ Fluent InteractionTag).

components.name: Text input
components.purpose: Field for entering free-form text.
components.notes: Also documents Text area and Password input; default and fluid styles.

components.name: Tile
components.purpose: A flexible container for grouping content, optionally clickable, selectable, or expandable.
components.notes: Base, clickable, selectable (~ Fluent Card selectable / radio tile), expandable. Carbon has no Card; tile is the foundation.

components.name: Toggle
components.purpose: A switch that turns a setting on or off.

components.name: Toggletip
components.purpose: A small popup opened by clicking an info icon that can hold links or buttons.
components.notes: Interactive counterpart to Tooltip (like M3 rich tooltip, Fluent InfoLabel).

components.name: Tooltip
components.purpose: Shows brief non-essential help text on hover or focus.
components.notes: Definition tooltip remains a separate component; icon/standard tooltips are embedded in other components.

components.name: Tree view
components.purpose: Hierarchical list of nested items that can be expanded and collapsed.

components.name: UI shell
components.purpose: The persistent app frame: global header, side navigation, and utility panels.
components.notes: Split into three documented parts: UI shell header, UI shell left panel (side nav), UI shell right panel (switcher/utility panel). Implements the Global header pattern.

components.name: Combo box
components.purpose: Dropdown where users can type to filter options or enter a custom value.
components.notes: Documented within Dropdown page; separate React component (ComboBox). Equivalent to Fluent Combobox / Ant AutoComplete-Select with search.

components.name: Overflow menu
components.purpose: An icon button (three dots) that opens a menu of extra actions.
components.notes: Documented within Menu buttons; separate React component (OverflowMenu).

components.name: Combo button
components.purpose: A primary action button joined to a menu of secondary actions.
components.notes: Documented within Menu buttons; Carbon's split button (M3 Split buttons, Fluent SplitButton).

components.name: Text area
components.purpose: Multi-line field for longer free-form text.
components.notes: Documented within Text input; separate React component (TextArea).

components.name: Time picker
components.purpose: Field for entering a time with AM/PM and time zone selectors.
components.notes: Documented within Date picker page; separate React component (TimePicker).

components.name: UI shell left panel
components.purpose: Collapsible side navigation for moving between product sections.
components.notes: Part of UI shell (SideNav).

components.name: UI shell right panel
components.purpose: Panel opened from header icons for switchers, notifications, or utilities.
components.notes: Part of UI shell (HeaderPanel / Switcher).

components.name: Definition tooltip
components.purpose: Dotted-underlined term that shows its definition on hover or focus.
components.notes: Called out on the Tooltip page as the one tooltip that remains a separate component.

components.name: 2x Grid
components.purpose: Responsive column grid for laying out pages.
components.notes: From Elements, not the components index; ships as Grid/Column (and FlexGrid) React components.

components.name: Skeleton states
components.purpose: Grey placeholder shapes shown while content loads.
components.notes: From the Loading pattern, not the components index; ships as SkeletonText, SkeletonPlaceholder, and per-component skeleton variants.

systems.notes: 69 v5 components + Util (_util). The overview also links Pro Components (ProLayout, ProForm, ProTable, ProDescriptions, ProList, EditableProTable) in the separate @ant-design/pro-components package; not listed. The current ant.design (v6) adds Masonry, Listy (6.6, grouped virtual list), and BorderBeam (6.4, decorative animated border), which are not in v5.

components.name: Button
components.purpose: Starts an immediate action when clicked.
components.notes: Types primary/default/dashed/text/link; danger, ghost, loading. Dropdown.Button covers split buttons.

components.name: FloatButton
components.purpose: A floating button fixed on the page for global actions such as back-to-top.
components.notes: FloatButton.Group (menu of floating buttons, like M3 FAB menu) and FloatButton.BackTop (replaces old BackTop).

components.name: Icon
components.purpose: Shows semantic vector icons.
components.notes: Icons ship in @ant-design/icons.

components.name: Typography
components.purpose: Basic text styles for titles, paragraphs, and inline text with copy/edit/ellipsis.
components.notes: Typography.Title, Text, Paragraph, Link.

components.name: Divider
components.purpose: A line that separates content, optionally with text.
components.notes: Horizontal and vertical.

components.name: Flex
components.purpose: Flexbox wrapper for aligning and spacing children.
components.notes: Added in 5.10.

components.name: Grid
components.purpose: 24-column responsive row/column grid system.
components.notes: Row and Col.

components.name: Layout
components.purpose: Page-level frame with header, sider, content, and footer regions.
components.notes: Layout.Header, Sider, Content, Footer.

components.name: Space
components.purpose: Sets consistent spacing between inline or stacked elements.
components.notes: Space.Compact joins inputs/buttons into one compact group.

components.name: Splitter
components.purpose: Splits an area into resizable, collapsible panels.
components.notes: Added in 5.21. Resizable panes (not purely presentational).

components.name: Anchor
components.purpose: In-page table of contents that jumps to and highlights sections.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.purpose: Shows the current page's location in the hierarchy and links back up.

components.name: Dropdown
components.purpose: A menu of actions that pops down from a trigger.
components.notes: Dropdown.Button is the split-button variant.

components.name: Menu
components.purpose: Navigation menu for pages and functions, horizontal or vertical/inline.
components.notes: Also used inside Dropdown. Sider menu is the app side nav.

components.name: Pagination
components.purpose: Splits long lists into pages with page-jump controls.

components.name: Steps
components.purpose: Shows progress through the steps of a multi-step task.
components.notes: Equivalent to Carbon Progress indicator.

components.name: Tabs
components.purpose: Switches between views at the same level.
components.notes: Line, card, editable-card types.

components.name: AutoComplete
components.purpose: Text input that suggests completions as the user types.

components.name: Cascader
components.purpose: Picks a value from a multi-level hierarchy of options in cascading columns.
components.notes: Distinct Ant component; no direct equivalent in M3, Carbon, or Fluent.

components.name: Checkbox
components.purpose: Selects one or more options from a set.
components.notes: Checkbox.Group.

components.name: ColorPicker
components.purpose: Lets users choose a color.
components.notes: Added in 5.5. Fluent has ColorPicker/SwatchPicker; not in M3 or Carbon.

components.name: DatePicker
components.purpose: Picks a date or date range from a popup calendar.
components.notes: RangePicker; week/month/quarter/year pickers.

components.name: Form
components.purpose: Collects, validates, and submits data with labeled fields.
components.notes: Form.Item, Form.List for dynamic fields.

components.name: Input
components.purpose: Basic text field for keyboard input.
components.notes: Sub-components that are separate components elsewhere: Input.TextArea, Input.Search, Input.Password, Input.OTP (5.16).

components.name: InputNumber
components.purpose: Numeric field with step up/down controls.

components.name: Mentions
components.purpose: Text area that suggests people or tags after typing @ or another trigger.
components.notes: Distinct Ant component.

components.name: Radio
components.purpose: Selects a single option from a set.
components.notes: Radio.Group; button-style radios act like a segmented control.

components.name: Rate
components.purpose: Star rating input.
components.notes: Equivalent to Fluent Rating.

components.name: Select
components.purpose: Dropdown for choosing one or more options.
components.notes: Modes: single, multiple, tags; searchable. Covers combobox/multiselect cases.

components.name: Slider
components.purpose: Selects a value or range by dragging.
components.notes: Range mode.

components.name: Switch
components.purpose: Toggles between two states.

components.name: TimePicker
components.purpose: Picks a time from a popup.
components.notes: TimePicker.RangePicker.

components.name: Transfer
components.purpose: Moves items between two side-by-side lists to select a subset.
components.notes: Distinct Ant component (dual-list selector); no equivalent in M3, Carbon, or Fluent.

components.name: TreeSelect
components.purpose: Dropdown select whose options are a tree.
components.notes: Distinct Ant component.

components.name: Upload
components.purpose: Uploads files by selecting or dragging.
components.notes: Upload.Dragger; picture list/card styles.

components.name: Avatar
components.purpose: Shows a user or entity as an image, icon, or initials.
components.notes: Avatar.Group.

components.name: Badge
components.purpose: Small count or dot on an element, usually for notifications.
components.notes: Badge.Ribbon.

components.name: Calendar
components.purpose: Full calendar view for showing date-based data.
components.notes: Display calendar (not a picker).

components.name: Card
components.purpose: A container for content on a single subject.
components.notes: Card.Meta, Card.Grid.

components.name: Carousel
components.purpose: Rotating set of slides.

components.name: Collapse
components.purpose: Panels that expand and collapse; an accordion.
components.notes: Accordion mode.

components.name: Descriptions
components.purpose: Read-only list of label/value pairs.
components.notes: Distinct Ant component (description list).

components.name: Empty
components.purpose: Placeholder shown when there is no data.
components.notes: Empty-state component (Carbon treats this as a pattern).

components.name: Image
components.purpose: Image with preview/zoom support.
components.notes: Image.PreviewGroup.

components.name: List
components.purpose: Displays a list of items with optional actions, pagination, and loading.

components.name: Popover
components.purpose: Floating card with content that appears on hover or click.

components.name: QRCode
components.purpose: Renders text or a URL as a QR code.
components.notes: Added in 5.1. Distinct Ant component.

components.name: Segmented
components.purpose: A row of joined options for switching views or picking one value.
components.notes: Equivalent to M3 Segmented buttons / Carbon Content switcher.

components.name: Statistic
components.purpose: Shows a number or stat with a title, prefix, and suffix.
components.notes: Statistic.Countdown (Statistic.Timer in 5.25).

components.name: Table
components.purpose: Displays rows and columns of data with sorting, filtering, selection, and pagination.

components.name: Tag
components.purpose: Short label for marking and categorizing.
components.notes: Tag.CheckableTag (selectable tag); closable tags.

components.name: Timeline
components.purpose: Vertical list of events in time order.

components.name: Tooltip
components.purpose: Short text shown on hover.

components.name: Tour
components.purpose: Step-by-step guided walkthrough that highlights parts of the UI.
components.notes: Added in 5.0. Equivalent to Fluent TeachingPopover.

components.name: Tree
components.purpose: Hierarchical list with expand, select, check, and drag.

components.name: Alert
components.purpose: Inline message box for warnings, info, success, or errors.
components.notes: Equivalent to Fluent MessageBar / Carbon inline notification.

components.name: Drawer
components.purpose: A panel that slides in from the edge of the screen.

components.name: Message
components.purpose: Brief global message at the top of the page that disappears automatically.
components.notes: Called via API (message.success()). Similar to M3 Snackbar.

components.name: Modal
components.purpose: A dialog window for focused tasks or confirmations.
components.notes: Modal.confirm/info/success/error/warning static methods.

components.name: Notification
components.purpose: Global notification card in a screen corner, with title and details.
components.notes: Equivalent to Fluent Toast / Carbon toast notification.

components.name: Popconfirm
components.purpose: Small popup asking to confirm an action next to the trigger.
components.notes: Distinct Ant component (inline confirmation popover).

components.name: Progress
components.purpose: Shows progress of an operation as a line, circle, or dashboard.

components.name: Result
components.purpose: Full-area page showing the outcome of an operation (success, error, 404...).
components.notes: Distinct Ant component.

components.name: Skeleton
components.purpose: Grey placeholder shapes shown while content loads.

components.name: Spin
components.purpose: Spinner showing a section or page is loading.

components.name: Watermark
components.purpose: Adds a text or image watermark over an area.
components.notes: Added in 5.1. Distinct Ant component.

components.name: Affix
components.purpose: Pins an element to the viewport while scrolling.

components.name: App
components.purpose: Wrapper that provides context for message/notification/modal hooks and reset styles.
components.notes: Added in 5.1.

components.name: ConfigProvider
components.purpose: Sets global config such as theme, locale, and component defaults.

components.name: Util
components.purpose: Shared utilities such as GetRef and GetProps type helpers.
components.notes: Not a UI component.

systems.notes: 47 components on the Fluent 2 design site (web/react) plus components that exist only in the Fluent UI React v9 Storybook (https://react.fluentui.dev). Motion preview components (Fade, Scale, Slide, Collapse, Blur, Rotate) omitted as animation utilities.

components.name: Accordion
components.purpose: Expandable/collapsible sections of content.

components.name: Avatar
components.purpose: Shows a person or entity as an image, initials, or icon.

components.name: Avatar group
components.purpose: Shows a group of avatars, stacked or spread, with overflow.

components.name: Badge
components.purpose: Small visual indicator for status, count, or attention.
components.notes: React v9 splits into Badge, CounterBadge, PresenceBadge (separate docs pages).

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.purpose: Shows the current location in a hierarchy with links back up.

components.name: Button
components.purpose: Triggers an action.
components.notes: React v9 ships Button, CompoundButton, MenuButton, SplitButton, ToggleButton as separate components (listed below).

components.name: Card
components.purpose: A container grouping information and actions about one subject.
components.notes: React v9 parts: CardHeader, CardPreview, CardFooter; selectable cards.

components.name: Carousel
components.purpose: Rotating set of slides with navigation controls.
components.notes: React v9 includes CarouselNav.

components.name: Checkbox
components.purpose: Selects one or more options, or toggles one option.

components.name: Combobox
components.purpose: Text field with a dropdown list the user can type to filter or pick from.
components.notes: Supports multiselect and freeform.

components.name: Dialog
components.purpose: A modal or non-modal window for focused tasks or confirmations.
components.notes: Modal, non-modal, alert.

components.name: Divider
components.purpose: A line separating content, optionally with a label.

components.name: Drawer
components.purpose: A panel that slides in from the edge for extra content or navigation.
components.notes: OverlayDrawer and InlineDrawer.

components.name: Dropdown
components.purpose: Button-like control that opens a list of options to pick from (no typing).

components.name: Field
components.purpose: Wraps a form control with a label, hint, and validation message.

components.name: Fluent provider
components.purpose: Supplies theme, direction, and styling context to Fluent components.

components.name: Icon
components.purpose: Shows Fluent system icons.
components.notes: Icons ship in @fluentui/react-icons.

components.name: Image
components.purpose: Displays an image with fit and shape options.

components.name: Info label
components.purpose: A label with an info icon that opens a popover with more details.
components.notes: Similar to Carbon Toggletip.

components.name: Input
components.purpose: Single-line text field.

components.name: Label
components.purpose: Text label for a form control.

components.name: Link
components.purpose: Text that navigates somewhere or triggers an action.

components.name: List
components.purpose: Accessible list of items, optionally selectable and interactive.

components.name: Menu
components.purpose: A popup list of actions or options.
components.notes: React v9 also documents MenuList (inline menu) and preview MenuGrid.

components.name: Message bar
components.purpose: Inline banner for status, warnings, or errors in a region.
components.notes: Equivalent to Ant Alert / Carbon inline notification.

components.name: Nav
components.purpose: Side navigation for moving between app sections.
components.notes: NavDrawer; categories and subitems.

components.name: Persona
components.purpose: Shows a person's avatar with name, status, and secondary text.

components.name: Popover
components.purpose: A floating surface with content attached to a trigger.

components.name: Progress bar
components.purpose: Horizontal bar showing progress of a task.

components.name: Radio group
components.purpose: Choose exactly one option from a set.

components.name: Rating
components.purpose: Star rating input.
components.notes: React v9 also ships RatingDisplay (read-only).

components.name: Searchbox
components.purpose: Text field specialized for search with search/clear icons.

components.name: Select
components.purpose: Native select for choosing one option.

components.name: Skeleton
components.purpose: Placeholder shapes shown while content loads.

components.name: Slider
components.purpose: Pick a value by dragging along a track.
components.notes: Single value only (no range).

components.name: Spin button
components.purpose: Numeric field with increment/decrement buttons.

components.name: Spinner
components.purpose: Animated indicator that something is loading.

components.name: Switch
components.purpose: Toggles a setting on or off.

components.name: Tablist
components.purpose: A row of tabs for switching views.

components.name: Tag
components.purpose: Compact label representing an item, attribute, or person, optionally dismissible.
components.notes: React v9: Tag, InteractionTag (tag with primary + secondary actions), TagGroup.

components.name: Tag picker
components.purpose: Combobox that lets users pick multiple items shown as tags in the input.
components.notes: Distinct Fluent component (people/tag picker); Ant uses Select mode='tags', Carbon uses Multiselect.

components.name: Text
components.purpose: Displays text with Fluent type ramp styles.
components.notes: Presets like Title1, Body1, Caption1.

components.name: Textarea
components.purpose: Multi-line text field.

components.name: Toast
components.purpose: Temporary notification that appears and disappears in a screen corner.
components.notes: Toaster + useToastController.

components.name: Toolbar
components.purpose: A row of buttons and controls for related commands.

components.name: Tooltip
components.purpose: Short text shown on hover or focus.

components.name: Tree
components.purpose: Hierarchical list with expandable nodes.
components.notes: Tree and FlatTree.

components.name: CounterBadge
components.purpose: Badge that shows a number count.
components.notes: React v9 only; Fluent 2 design covers it under Badge.

components.name: PresenceBadge
components.purpose: Badge showing a person's availability (available, busy, away...).
components.notes: React v9 only; Fluent 2 design covers it under Badge.

components.name: CompoundButton
components.purpose: Button with a primary label plus secondary descriptive text.
components.notes: React v9; Fluent 2 design covers under Button.

components.name: MenuButton
components.purpose: Button that opens a menu.
components.notes: React v9; Carbon Menu button equivalent.

components.name: SplitButton
components.purpose: Button with a main action and a separate menu trigger.
components.notes: React v9; equivalents M3 Split buttons, Carbon Combo button.

components.name: ToggleButton
components.purpose: Button that stays pressed/unpressed to toggle a state.
components.notes: React v9.

components.name: ColorPicker
components.purpose: Lets users pick a color with area, hue, and alpha sliders.
components.notes: React v9 only; no Fluent 2 design page.

components.name: SwatchPicker
components.purpose: Lets users pick a color or image from a grid/row of swatches.
components.notes: React v9 only; distinct Fluent component.

components.name: DataGrid
components.purpose: Feature-rich data table with sorting, selection, resizing, and keyboard grid navigation.
components.notes: React v9 only; built on Table.

components.name: Table
components.purpose: Primitive table for showing tabular data.
components.notes: React v9 only.

components.name: InteractionTag
components.purpose: Tag with a primary click action and an optional secondary (dismiss) action.
components.notes: React v9; Carbon operational tag is similar.

components.name: TagGroup
components.purpose: Container managing a set of tags, including dismissal and focus.
components.notes: React v9.

components.name: TeachingPopover
components.purpose: A popover that teaches or onboards users, optionally in multiple steps.
components.notes: React v9 only; equivalent to Ant Tour.

components.name: MenuList
components.purpose: The list part of a menu rendered inline without a popup.
components.notes: React v9.

components.name: MenuGrid
components.purpose: Menu laid out as a grid with row-level actions.
components.notes: React v9 preview component.

components.name: Overflow
components.purpose: Hides items that don't fit and moves them to an overflow menu.
components.notes: React v9 utility component used by Toolbar/TabList patterns.

components.name: Portal
components.purpose: Renders children into a different part of the DOM (e.g. for overlays).
components.notes: React v9 utility.

components.name: RatingDisplay
components.purpose: Read-only star rating display.
components.notes: React v9.

components.name: CarouselNav
components.purpose: Dot/thumbnail controls for moving between carousel slides.
components.notes: React v9 sub-component of Carousel.

components.name: Calendar (compat)
components.purpose: Month calendar for picking a date.
components.notes: React v9 compat component ported from v8.

components.name: DatePicker (compat)
components.purpose: Input with a popup calendar for picking a date.
components.notes: React v9 compat component; Fluent 2 has no design page for date picker.

components.name: TimePicker (compat)
components.purpose: Combobox for picking a time of day.
components.notes: React v9 compat component.

components.name: AriaLiveAnnouncer
components.purpose: Announces messages to screen readers via an ARIA live region.
components.notes: React v9 utility.
